transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I suppose it's about our kitchen. It's been nearly two years now, and... I'm just sure the contractor and some of the people on our block are quietly working together. To cheat us. They keep leaving my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. My husband keeps showing me receipts, and they always have some excuse, but... well, I know what's going on. So, that's why I'm here.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?
No... no, nothing like that. Just... just the things they actually say to me. That's all.
Aside from feeling frustrated about the kitchen, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless?
No... I wouldn't say that. I'm not sad. Just... tired of the whole situation with the house, I suppose. But no, I'm fine.
